# DocumentNavigator

**Class:** `UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator` · **Group:** [Text entry](../Groups/Text-entry.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A **document navigator** beside an `UltraCanvasRichTextEdit` — the headings as a tree that follows the caret (promote, demote, move or drag a chapter), tables, pictures, charts, comments with their authors, bookmarks, notes and tracked changes, a search box that filters them and lists the finds ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator.md)
- [UltraCanvasRichTextEdit](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.md)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height);
explicit UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onCommentActivated` | `std::function<void(int commentIndex)> onCommentActivated` | A comment's entry was double-clicked; unset, the list of comments (ShowCommentsDialog) opens. |
| `onEntryActivated` | `std::function<void(EntryKind kind, int index)> onEntryActivated` | An entry was gone to (after the caret moved). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetEdit` | `void SetEdit(const std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRichTextEdit>& edit)` | The edit whose document is listed; held weakly. Null lists nothing. |
| `SetRefreshDelay` | `void SetRefreshDelay(int milliseconds)` | How long after an edit the lists are read again (milliseconds); 0 = at once, after every edit. |
| `SetFilterText` | `void SetFilterText(const std::string& text)` | What the search box holds: every list shows only the entries whose words contain it (any case, any script; a heading also when one under it does), and "Found in the text" lists where the document says it. |
